differences.reason: Evolution throws a BigInteger overflow and fails to complete simulation.
Evolution leaves the Reptar Local Bus unsimulated.
Evolution requires QuestaSim to simulate a VHDL entity. Under the maintainer's November 7, 2026 decision, QuestaSim is out of scope and Mobile simulates through the companion.
With a HIGH trigger and error inputs, Evolution opens a dialog that fails in headless mode.
The fixture changes a width without supplying table rows. Both programs open the PLA as 2×2, which makes the probe points incompatible.
With seed 0 and Evolution appearances, Evolution uses System.currentTimeMillis() and Mobile uses deterministic seeding.
Evolution times the 74123 pulse with System.nanoTime() and Mobile uses simulated time.

These rows date to 51b03c89 and 72b6bae3, when Mobile co-simulated BLIF through the companion. Since #335, Mobile simulates BLIF the same way as Evolution. The blif-circuit evidence reruns these suites for BLIF alone and compares the results with Evolution.
Evolution cannot resave the BLIF truth table in headless mode because the parse error opens a dialog. The corpus suites compare the same fixture in settle and step modes.
